title: firstlines (a small head)
summary: Copy the first N lines of stdin; handle -N and very long lines.
hints: fgets returns a piece of a line when the line is longer than the buffer: only count a line when the piece ends with '\n'.
Parse the option with atoi(argv[1] + 1) when argv[1][0] == '-'.
info: fgets(buf, size, stdin) reads up to size-1 characters or up to and including a newline. If the line is longer, the rest comes in the next call.
